openapi: 3.1.0
info:
  title: SCOPe REST API
  version: v1
  description: >
    Read-only JSON API for low-cost SCOP/ASTRAL/SCOPe lookups, release-scoped
    hierarchy traversal, indexed search, static-download manifests, and
    paginated collections. Biological data endpoints are release-scoped for
    data selection. Base releases such as 2.08 can receive periodic updates;
    dated selectors do not promise immutable archived snapshots.
    The site's /.well-known/api-catalog provides machine-readable discovery;
    HTTP Link headers advertise the api-catalog and service-desc relations.
servers:
  - url: https://scop.berkeley.edu/api/v1
tags:
  - {name: metadata}
  - {name: search}
  - {name: releases}
  - {name: nodes}
  - {name: pdb}
  - {name: sequences}
  - {name: astral}
  - {name: downloads}
paths:
  /:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getServiceIndex
      summary: Service metadata and canonical endpoint hints
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ServiceIndex'}
  /openapi.yaml:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: getOpenApiYaml
      summary: OpenAPI document
      responses:
        '200': {description: OK}
  /levels:
    get:
      tags: [metadata]
      operationId: listLevels
      summary: SCOP hierarchy levels
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/LevelsResponse'}
  /releases:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: listReleases
      summary: List public SCOP/SCOPe releases
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ReleasesResponse'}
  /releases/current:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getCurrentRelease
      summary: Current public release, including latest periodic update label where applicable
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /releases/{release}:
    get:
      tags: [releases]
      operationId: getRelease
      summary: Public release metadata and current periodic update label
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Release'}
  /search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchCurrentRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in the current release
      description: >
        Uses materialized API search tables. This endpoint does not run broad
        MySQL full-text or leading-wildcard searches. Use it for discovery,
        then fetch exact release-scoped node/PDB endpoints for interpretation.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /downloads:
    get:
      tags: [downloads]
      operationId: listCurrentDownloads
      summary: Static download manifest for the current release
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/DownloadsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/root:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getReleaseRoot
      summary: Root node for a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/search:
    get:
      tags: [search]
      operationId: searchRelease
      summary: Indexed discovery search in a specific release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchQuery'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/searchMode'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/SearchOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '422': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/resolve/{identifier}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: resolveIdentifier
      summary: Resolve a public SCOPe identifier in a release
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - name: identifier
          in: path
          required: true
          schema: {type: string}
      responses:
        '200':
          description: OK
          content:
            application/json:
              schema: {$ref: '#/components/schemas/ResolveResponse'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySunid
      summary: Node by public SUNID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/LineageOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/children:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidChildren
      summary: Seek-paginated child nodes
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/limit'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/cursor'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ChildrenOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/annotations:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidAnnotations
      summary: Comments, inconsistencies, repeats, and xrefs
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/AnnotationsOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/images:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidImages
      summary: Thumbnail and larger static images for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/ImagesOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/homology:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidHomology
      summary: Homology scope and warnings for a node
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/HomologyOk'}
  /releases/{release}/sunids/{sunid}/fatcat-chain-statistics:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSunidFatcatChainStatistics
      summary: Node-specific FATCAT chain-statistics classification consistency
      description: >
        Returns the classification match fraction and observation count for a
        family, superfamily, or fold SUNID. These are stored historical
        classification-consistency aggregates, not evidence of homology or the
        probability that a current hit is correct. Provenance fields are omitted
        pending a better provenance implementation. No provenance metadata table
        is required. The release parameter selects the classification context.
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sunid'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/statisticsMinimumSupportingHits'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/FatcatChainStatisticsOk'}
        '400': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
        '503': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getNodeBySid
      summary: Node by public SCOPe domain identifier
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/sid'}
      responses:
        '200': {$ref: '#/components/responses/NodeOk'}
        '404': {$ref: '#/components/responses/Problem'}
  /releases/{release}/sids/{sid}/parents:
    get:
      tags: [nodes]
      operationId: getSidParents
      summary: Node parent lineage for a SID
      parameters:
        - {$ref: '#/components/parameters/releasePath'}

item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q026_protein_kinase_like_function_transfer","answer":"In the current public SCOPe base release 2.08, all three catalytic domains are in the alpha-and-beta class d, Protein kinase-like fold d.144 (SUNID 56111), and—more significantly—the same Protein kinase-like superfamily d.144.1 (SUNID 56112), for which SCOPe explicitly implies homology. Thus a homologous catalytic-domain core and a shared broad ATP-dependent phosphoryl-transfer framework are justified, not merely convergent fold similarity. They are nevertheless separate families: phosphoinositide 3-kinase catalytic domains d.144.1.4 (SUNID 56171), APH phosphotransferases including aminoglycoside phosphotransferases d.144.1.6 (SUNID 64411), and canonical protein-kinase catalytic subunits d.144.1.7 (SUNID 88854). This separation reflects substantial divergence: canonical protein kinases generally phosphorylate protein residues, APHs phosphorylate aminoglycosides, and PI3Ks phosphorylate phosphoinositide lipids. Superfamily membership therefore does not justify transferring a particular substrate, residue/lipid position, inhibitor profile, kinetic behavior, activation mechanism, interaction partner, localization, or regulatory circuit among them.\n\nSpecificity transfer requires evidence substantially closer than a shared superfamily: preferably orthology or well-supported phylogeny within the same family/subfamily; conservation of catalytic and specificity-determining residues, insertions, substrate-binding surfaces, and domain boundaries; and structures—ideally substrate/nucleotide/metal complexes—in a relevant catalytic conformation. It should be confirmed by direct binding and kinetic assays against plausible substrates, specificity profiling, and perturbation of predicted recognition residues. Regulation additionally requires evidence for the complete protein context: accessory and regulatory domains, activation loops or other modifications, partner proteins, oligomeric state, membrane/lipid recruitment, localization, and cellular or genetic responses. A cross-family structure can be used as a remote template for the conserved catalytic core or to propose an active-site hypothesis, but not reliably for variable loops, substrate pockets, full-length architecture, regulatory state, or function. Representative structures should therefore be selected from the same family—and preferably a close ortholog with matching ligands, activation state, domain composition, and adequate coverage—rather than treating one member of d.144.1 as representative of all three families.","evidence_used":["Pretrained model knowledge","/api/v1/","/api/v1/openapi.yaml","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=protein%20kinases&mode=token","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=aminoglycoside%20phosphotransferases&mode=token","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=phosphoinositide%203-kinases&mode=token","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=aminoglycoside%20phosphotransferase&mode=token&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=PI3K&mode=token&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/search?q=phosphoinositide%203-kinase&mode=token&limit=10","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/88854/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/64412/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/56172/parents","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/56111/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/56112/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/88854/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/64411/homology","/api/v1/releases/2.08/sunids/56171/homology"]}]}
